source: Unified Government Code of Ordinances Chapter 27 and official KCK zoning GIS

universal_rules.rule: Use the zoning GIS result as a planning reference and verify the official zoning map and applicable schedule of district regulations before filing.
Historic and environs GIS flags trigger Historic Preservation review and may require a Certificate of Appropriateness.
A split-zone GIS flag requires parcel-specific confirmation of every applicable district boundary.
Development in the regulatory floodplain requires the floodplain approval before grading, fill, or construction.
